surface_name: TypeScript SDK and duplicate Zod copies
title: TS2589 'Type instantiation is excessively deep and possibly infinite' when registering MCP tools
symptoms: TS2589: Type instantiation is excessively deep and possibly infinite
The error points at an unrelated-looking registerTool or ToolCallback call site
cause: Two copies of zod in the dependency tree make TypeScript instantiate cross-version schema types until it hits its recursion limit.
fix: Align the project on one Zod 4 version and force it with an override when a transitive dependency pins another copy.
affected: @modelcontextprotocol/sdk 1.x and @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.x with mixed zod versions, as of 2026-10
